thread:
emily (platform): Heads-up: launching a new Dedicated GPU SKU: NVIDIA H200 80GB (sku=h200-80). Initial regions: eu-central-1 and ap-south-1. Reservations open 2026-04-08 09:00 UTC.

raj (infra): Benchmarks: ~1.6x throughput vs our h100 baseline for long-context workloads. Expect transient P99 jitter while autoscaling and KV caches warm.

zoe (sales): Pricing adjustments? Need to update SOW templates and deal quotes.

emily (platform): List price = 1.25x h100. Standard reserved discounts apply. I'll push an interim pricing sheet to sales-drive this afternoon.

sam (solutions): Migration notes: in-place rollovers supported. Run the migration checker first; quantized KV cache compatibility varies. Also: ap-south-1 launch will have NVLink disabled initially 94 call out to customers doing multi-gpu sharding.

devops-bot: Job reserve-capacity-1764129999 created for eu-central-1/ap-south-1. Allocation window 2026-04-08..2026-04-10.

raj (infra): Monitoring metrics added: model_inference_gpu_util_h200, h200_gpu_temp_c, h200_oom_count. Default alert: P95 util >85% for 10m.

emily (platform): Soft quota = 56 GPUs per org across both regions for first 30 days; larger requests via capacity@redwood. Read runbook before approving: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/dedicated-h200.

zoe (sales): I'll update the FAQ and notify customers on EA and reserved plans.

emily (platform): TL;DR: H200-80 dedicated in eu-central-1 + ap-south-1; reservations open 2026-04-08 09:00 UTC; pricing 1.25x h100; soft cap 56 GPUs/org. Ping capacity@redwood for exceptions. :rocket:
